confluence.title: Master Spatial Cockpit (Kitty)
confluence.description: GPU-accelerated fullscreen Kitty instance with native tiled splits mirroring physical workspace topology.
confluence.best_for: Multi-node parallel audits, distributed debugging, live cross-fleet streaming, and collaborative pair-programming.
superpowers: Simultaneous live visibility of all swarm nodes on anchor display
Shared prompt cache acceleration across concurrent sessions
Instant keyboard switching and human takeover across any pane
Zero risk of KDE Connect clipboard echo loops
limitations: Requires graphical desktop environment on anchor machine
Occupies screen real estate during run
Cannot render interactive HTML/Generative UI canvas elements

headless.title: Autonomous Background Fleet
headless.description: Background execution via systemd-run --user with --dangerously-skip-permissions reporting via GitHub Discussions.
headless.best_for: Unattended batch jobs, nightly regressions, cron maintenance, CI/CD sweeps, and headless/docked nodes.
superpowers: 100% unattended execution without screen or terminal dependencies
Zero screen distraction; runs seamlessly in background
Immune to terminal window closures or SSH pipe drops
Lowest token and resource overhead (~340k base context)
Easily scheduled via cron, timer, or CI hooks
limitations: No live streaming on screen without attaching
Cannot prompt human for inline plan review or interactive questions
No visual browser or HTML widget rendering

tui.title: Decentralized Physical Screens (Konsole)
tui.description: Dedicated interactive Konsole instances running agy -i on each target node's local Wayland display.
tui.best_for: Device-specific hardware testing, local thermal/power profiling, and ergonomic/gamepad verification.
superpowers: Renders directly on target machine's physical screen
Direct local keyboard/gamepad interaction on that specific device
Bypasses remote SSH PTY layer completely
limitations: Scattered visibility across separate physical rooms/screens
Requires active display session on each node
Awkward window management on small handheld screens

gui.title: Antigravity 2.0 Desktop App
gui.description: Electron desktop GUI canvas using staged file delivery and local clipboard helper to prevent echo loops.
gui.best_for: Frontend development, visual HTML/CSS layouts, Generative UI, and interactive artifact planning.
superpowers: Full rich interactive Generative UI and inline HTML rendering
Visual Chrome DevTools browser testing and DOM inspection
Collapsible visual diffs and auxiliary panel inspection
limitations: Highest base system prompt token overhead (~450k+ tokens)
Requires manual copy/paste per node to avoid KDE Connect clipboard echoing
Cannot run headlessly without human operator

archetypes.task: Audit codebase parity, documentation, and hardware features across desktop, laptop, rog-ally, and steamdeck with 1.5x coverage.
Run overnight regression test suite on all nodes, record results in discussion, and output pass/fail matrix.
Test Steam Deck gamepad controls, desktop mode switching, and APU power throttling profiles locally.
Design a new dashboard layout using Glassmorphism, Tailwind CSS, and interactive SVG diagrams.
Compile and verify kernel shims and C extensions across AMD ROCm, NVIDIA CUDA, and Intel APU simultaneously.
Run weekly Lynis security auditing and Pacman package drift analysis on all nodes at 3 AM.
Verify NetworkManager dispatcher script while roaming between Wi-Fi APs and monitor battery drain rate on laptop screen.
Create a multi-phase system migration plan, requiring interactive operator feedback on each milestone before execution.
